name: Ichiki Umi
source:
A second-year student. A cheerful girl in the broadcasting club.

She leads a carefree life playing around with Sasa and Nena, her best friends, also in the broadcasting club. Honest and direct to an almost dangerous degree, there's nothing Umi values more than friendship.

The type who wants to have fun with her lover.

Strength: Projecting her voice
Weaknesses: Humidity, scared of ghosts
Hobbies: Fortune-telling, new experiences
Skills: Live broadcasting, improvisation

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/kindredspirits/]English official website[/url]]
